proposal.summary: The report claims IBM TXSeries/CICS TX products can transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted via man-in-the-middle (MITM) techniques.
proposal.affected_product: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1; CICS TX Standard 11.1; CICS TX Advanced 10.1, 11.1

evidence_quotes.claim: The report claims IBM TXSeries/CICS TX products can transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted via man-in-the-middle (MITM) techniques.
evidence_quotes.quote: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1, CICS TX Standard, 11.1, CICS TX Advanced 10.1, and 11.1 could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques.
